 Let’s Eat and Drink and Be Merry, For Tomorrow…
 Skip to comments 
 D. D. Degg 
 Published: November 12, 2026 
 Updated: November 12, 2026 
 1 minute 
 5 comments 
 Pogo by Walt Kelly – Dec. 8, 1960 
 Lucas Caldwell reporting for Nature World News: 
 “On Nov. 4, 1960, the journal Science published ‘Doomsday: Friday, 13 November, A.D. 2026,’ which concluded that world population would race toward infinity on that date.”
 A month later it became fodder for Walt Kelly and a subject for 3 days of Pogo .

 Atanwat 
 If I had seen those strips back when they originally ran, I’m sure that I would have cut them out and saved them to check the accuracy of the prediction. Unfortunately, at that time I hadn’t even been born yet.
 P.S. A quick check of the world’s population by year shows that the prediction was for the number to double (from 3 billion to 6 billion). That actually happened 28 years ago (in 1998), the current estimate for 2026 is 8.3 billion.
 Nov 12,2026

 Paul Berge 
 It’s worth noting that the rate of world population growth these days (percentage) is half what it was in 1960

 It’s too early to tell.
Let’s see who’s around on Saturday.
It’s odd he didn’t see us getting past the 2nd administration of 47, but I can see why.
